regions.text: 要するに様相性の第三の鐙系の根幹は一方に必然1可能の大小對當の相開を目撃し、他方に不可能ー偶然の大小對営の相開を目撃するとこうに存するのである。

quote.translation: In short, the core of the third system of Modality lies in witnessing, on the one hand, the correlation of subalternation between the necessary and the possible and, on the other, the correlation of subalternation between the impossible and the contingent.

regions.text: 必然性は可能性の極限として「超可能性を云はれることがあるが、不可能性を偶然性の極限として「超偶然性云へないこともない。

quote.translation: Necessity, as the limit of possibility, is sometimes called "super-possibility", and in the same way we could call impossibility, as the limit of contingency, "super-contingency".

regions.text: 第三の酸系の立場を左の如く図形化することが出來る。

quote.translation: The standpoint of the third system can be put in the form of a figure 〔Figure 10〕.

regions.text: この図に於て圓間は必熱働を表はし弧は雨能倒を表はす。切線STは和恥能性を表はし切點Sは倒然他を表はす。

quote.translation: In this figure the circumference represents necessity and the arc represents possibility; the tangent ST represents impossibility, and the point of tangency S represents contingency.

regions.text: 切踏Sが曲線の生産點として自己から出發し、矢の方向へ進行して全園間を生産し終ったときに静止する。

quote.translation: As the producing point of the curve, S sets out from itself, advances in the direction of the arrow, and comes to rest when it has finished producing the whole circumference.

regions.text: 静止の狀態に於て把へられた側間と切點Sとが現實性を表はし運動の狀態に於て考へられた弧と切線STとが非測御を表はす。

quote.translation: The circumference and the point S, grasped in the state of rest, represent actuality; the arc and the tangent ST, thought in the state of motion, represent non-actuality.
